title: ERASED
source: ERASED (Boku dake ga Inai Machi) manga by Kei Sanbe (finished).
world: Struggling manga artist Satoru Fujinuma has 'Revival', a phenomenon that sends him back a few minutes before a tragedy so he can prevent it. When his mother is murdered, Revival sends him back to 1988 in his Hokkaido childhood, where he must save his classmate Kayo Hinazuki and others from a serial kidnapper. He succeeds but falls into a long coma and wakes years later to finish the fight with the real killer, his teacher Gaku Yashiro. A tense, touching mystery about courage and friendship.
power_system: No powers except Revival, which sends Satoru back in time before something bad happens.
